profile.subtitleJa: ユダとベニヤミンに関わる古代都市
profile.summaryJa: 士師記1:7は、捕らえられたアドニ・ベゼクがエルサレムへ連れて行かれてそこで死んだと記す。ここでは古代都市への移送が語られる。

facts.textJa: ユダの人々は町を攻め取り、剣で打ち、市に火を放った。
ベニヤミンは住民を追い出せず、エブス人がそこに住み続けた。
旅人はエブス（別名エルサレム）に近づく。

profile.modernLocationJa: 古代都市の歴史的中心域と現代エルサレム市は地理的範囲も政治的文脈も異なる。
profile.historicalRoleJa: アドニ・ベゼクの死地として最初に登場する古代都市。
profile.locationNoteJa: 記事は現代都市の歴史を扱う関連案内です。古代の市街と現代の市域を同じ境界として示しません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.
